title: October Won't Stay Quiet.
speaker: Figuring Out Money host

macro_themes.view: Q4 is typically bullish in midterm years, but 2018 shows it can roll over; Bollinger bandwidth compression means an expansionary move is coming either way.
Yields are the highest since 2007 and inversely track IWM; the 2018 analog peaked around Oct 5.
Equal-weight S&P diverging from the cap-weighted index; fewer names holding the market up.
Falling sentiment mirrors rising yields, like the early 1980s; Fed typically behind the curve.
44 sessions without a >1% down close; a >1% down day is common soon, but not a reason to short.
Nasdaq is right at the gamma flip line; breaking below it could increase volatility.

calls.condition: Micron/semis strength could keep SPY holding or higher; semis weakness could drive SPY through the lower weekly to the daily expected move (SPY 758). Watch lower monthly expected move (7363) and JPM collar put (7290) in a shock.
calls.reason: Seasonal Q4 bullish but compressed bands imply expansion either way; breadth weak and a >1% down day statistically due; SPX daily EM 7600-7670, monthly 7363-7939, quarterly 7090-8213.
calls.quote: we need to be prepared for if the market wants to rip, but know how to protect ourselves if the market starts to roll over

calls.condition: Bounce more likely if rates come in; if rates keep rising utilities could stay bearish.
calls.reason: Utilities bullish percent index at the same lows as Oct 2022/2023, which led to bounces; breadth extreme preceded XLU higher 3 months later 82% of the time.
calls.quote: if you were planning on shorting utilities, it's probably not the greatest time to short them at this current moment

calls.reason: Financials bullish percent near 30% with oversold RSI and bullish divergence, four weeks tagging the lower weekly expected move: mean-reversion bounce setup.
calls.quote: You can set up potentially trades looking for a bounce mean reverting trades ... in the short term for names that have been hammered

notes: Host says 'we made it through the month of September' and today was month end, so recorded Sep 30 after the close (listing approx 2026-10-01). SPY daily expected move 758-767 for next session. Financials ticker inferred as XLF (host says 'financials'). Micron mentioned only as a catalyst.
